meaning.en: An ion or group of ions having a positive charge and characteristically moving toward the negative electrode in electrolysis.

meaning.en: (chemistry) A positively charged ion—opposed to anion.

meaning.en: (chemistry) The ion in an electrolyzed solution that migrates to the cathode.
meaning.vi: (hóa học) Ion trong dung dịch bị điện phân di chuyển đến cực âm.
